game.name: Castlevania: Harmony of Dissonance DS
game.desc: Native static recompilation of Castlevania: Harmony of Dissonance (GBA), adapted to dual-screen handhelds running ROCKNIX. The top screen shows the game; the bottom touch screen shows the castle map, Juste's status, the port settings and the game's own pause menu and map screen. Requires your own USA ROM and GBA BIOS.
